prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one tightly framed 74x100 dialogue portrait for a grounded medieval pixel RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is the character identity master only; preserve identity and selected clothing, NOT its chibi anatomy or eye scale. Images 2, 3, 4 and 5 are the approved Mara v2, Ivo v1, Rhea v2, Tor v1 portrait STYLE AND FACE-COVERAGE anchors. Match their serious adult facial anatomy, coarse logical pixels and intentional hard-edged clusters.
Primary request: Redraw the named character as a single 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high head portrait. Think in those coarse logical pixels. If output is larger, make it a uniform enlargement of that grid, never detailed painting meant to be shrunk later.
Framing: EXTREME CLOSE HEAD, head/crown inside the frame with minimal top margin, face and hair occupy nearly the entire width and height. Short neck: chin or beard bottom near y=84 of 100; only the lowest 10-14 pixels show a narrow collar fragment. No chest or shoulder expanse. Head close to upright with slight three-quarter turn, readable entire face, not a bust.
Style: large connected matte color clusters, deliberate stair-step silhouette, hard angular cheek planes, substantial nose bridge/nostrils and firm lip/jaw anatomy. Warm near-black outline, muted warm terracotta/ochre skin and brown shadows, restrained material colors. At most 32 visible colors for this batch. Adult eye sockets: small dark eyes, whites no brighter than muted beige and only tiny slivers. No bright eye glints. Keep hair and beard in few broad connected masses. No antialiasing, smooth gradients, dithering, noise, isolated bright pixels, wispy strands or stubble speckles.
True transparent alpha outside silhouette. One person only. No background, frame, text, labels, panels, hands, held props, icons, modern items or extra anatomy.
Subject identity: Hase / 哈塞, BRY-NPC-HASE, a male commercial medicines agent around forty, not a physician. Preserve his master identity: dark brown short broad curly hair, substantial almost square adult nose, broad adult face and compact dark full beard, warm tan skin. Hair has 4-6 chunky curl masses; beard is 3-4 cohesive dark blocks with only a few large muted brown facets. Definite adult cheek planes and slight tiredness beside eyes, no elderly gray hair.
Distinct expression: composed commercial friendliness concealing calculation. Brows mostly relaxed and almost horizontal rather than a deep hostile V; small eyes glance subtly toward viewer-left as if watching a customer's reaction. Mouth visible within moustache: one corner very slightly lifted in a courteous close-lipped half-smile, no toothy grin or villain sneer. He is temperate, persuasive and carefully measuring, NOT angry, sad, a weary knight, or identical to Tor's frown.
Visible clothing at bottom: only a narrow dark forest-green merchant coat collar over muted cream linen, a tiny corner of tan self-made stock tag near the bottom edge WITHOUT any legible writing. Plain worn medieval merchant materials, no modern pointed lapels, doctor badge, medical cross, uniform, armor or rich jewelry. No medicine bottle or box needed in this face crop, no cure glow and no patient.
